mission_priority: XRP intelligence and prediction-engine mastery; Barrot V3 remains execution and verification foundation.

confirmed_facts.claim: Five Binance-labelled XRPL accounts sent exactly 233,461,943.1 native XRP to one receiver in five successful validated payments.
Bitquery's 06:43 UTC snapshot showed approximately 233.5M XRP at the attacker receiver and no outgoing transaction from that receiver at its observation cutoff.
Coinbase's cbXRP dashboard showed 151,405,263.6 XRP backing 151,403,016.07 cbXRP on Base, with 2,247.53 XRP excess reserve.
TradRadar's 07:00 UTC XRP perpetual panel showed $1.87B open interest, negative aggregate funding and long-dominated reported liquidations.
CoinDesk reported $1.53B market-wide liquidations, 83.8% longs and $38.1M XRP liquidations in its CoinGlass-based 24-hour snapshot.
XRPL fixCleanup3_5_0 is a proposed restricted-token compliance fix and was not merged or activated at publication.

sourced_claims.claim: Bitquery says all 17 drained wallets carried Binance proof-of-reserves labels in its address data.
sourced_claims.qualification: Secondary provider labels; not a direct official address-set crosswalk.

sourced_claims.claim: CoinDesk reports institutional investors are withdrawing from centralized exchanges after the Binance incident.
sourced_claims.qualification: Anonymous-source report; no amounts, destinations or XRP-specific attribution.

sourced_claims.claim: CoinDesk's review found Ethereum Binance 14 in Binance's October 1 PoR set.
sourced_claims.qualification: This does not identify the five XRPL wallets.

inferences.claim: The 233.46M XRP transfer is a potential future supply overhang, not confirmed selling pressure.
inferences.basis: The receiver was still reported holding the balance at 06:43 UTC; Bithomp's later 07:23 capture also showed no outgoing XRP in its displayed history.

inferences.claim: TrackWhale's negative seven-day tracked exchange flow is incident-contaminated and cannot be treated as voluntary holder withdrawal or bullish capital flight.
inferences.basis: Its window includes the large Binance theft transfer and only tracks a limited set of large transfers.

inferences.claim: Coinbase's cbXRP reserves represent measurable institutional native-XRP custody and a Base cross-chain wrapper, but a single reserve snapshot does not establish new spot buying.
inferences.basis: Official issuer reserve and supply figures; no matched historical change series in this capture.

inferences.claim: The XRPL restricted-token proposal could improve issuer compliance controls if activated, but it is not an operational change yet.
inferences.basis: Proposed code and validator activation threshold.

unknowns: Whether each of the five Binance XRPL source wallets appears in Binance's official October 1 downloadable PoR address set.
Whether any compromised source wallet is the XRP-BF2 backing address.
Whether Binance has replenished the XRP reserves and what its November 1 XRP-specific PoR ratio will be.
Whether the attacker receiver moved any XRP after the 07:23 Bithomp capture.
The amount and destination of institutional withdrawals reported by CoinDesk.
Whether the 35.6M USD-equivalent Ripple-labelled transfer at 06:42 UTC was a treasury, custody, payment or other transfer.
Whether Coinbase cbXRP reserve/supply changes represent net new XRP acquisition, internal custody migration or mint/redemption activity.

xrpl_protocol.required_activation: More than 80% of trusted validators for two consecutive weeks
xrpl_protocol.reported_user_impact: XRPL Foundation says no affected users known and no outsider exploitation known

source_independence.bitquery_trm_bithomp: Independent analytics/explorer providers examining the same public XRPL transactions; corroboration is analytical, not independent underlying events.
source_independence.coindesk_coinglass: CoinDesk's liquidation report relies on CoinGlass; count as one market-data lineage.
source_independence.tradradar: Separate multi-exchange aggregator with different venue coverage and a different rolling-window cutoff.
source_independence.trackwhale: Separate large-transfer tracker over the same public XRPL ledger; its sample is incomplete and incident-contaminated.
source_independence.coinbase: Issuer-published reserve dashboard; not independent audit evidence.
source_independence.institutional_withdrawals: Single anonymous-source media report; no corroborating quantified flow data.

prediction_reason: Asynchronous provider windows, incident-contaminated flow data, unverified official XRP PoR address membership and no calibrated fixed-horizon model.
